description: Letter, in Arabic script. Written in a petition-like fashion. Letter from Khidr to a dignitary, probably, titled Shams al-Riʾāsa. The sender, identified in the tarjama as al-mamlūk Khiḍr, reports that since leaving Cairo he has been diligently engaged in the service of Mawlānā. He mentions making a purchase for his master in accordance with instructions and refers to obtaining a letter from the qāḍī, although the surrounding details are unclear. He appeals to Mawlānā’s customary benevolence toward him and closes with a prayer and ḥasbala. Dating: Likely Mamluk-era.
description_he: מכתב בכתב ערבי. אפשרי שנשלח מאת ח'ידר. הוא מכנה את הנמען שמס אל-ריאסה. הוא מדווח כי מאז עזב את קהיר היה מוסר נפש בביצוע פקודות הנמען. דרוש בדיקה נוספת. תיארוך: ככל הנראה מתקופת הממלוכים.
